title: Canonical Governance envelope store and Production Recovery baseline handoff

phases.objective: Close the split-store capability-envelope failure without introducing a parallel Governance bootstrap engine: persisted migration envelopes are resolved and consumed only from the Governance store, while a zero-object Governance/Runtime-Persistence diagnosis produces a bounded read-only handoff to the existing role-selective Production Recovery baseline rebuild.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Migration 1050 readiness plus governed migration authorization/execute surfaces
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A persisted capability envelope is read and consumed from the canonical Governance store; if readiness proves exactly governance and runtime_persistence are zero-object roles, evidence contains the exact Recovery prepare command but dispatches or executes nothing automatically.
steps: Resolve persisted Migration 1050 authorization envelopes from getGovernancePool rather than the ordinary Runtime DB.
Keep authorization registry, apply-policy, dispatch-certification, and envelope lifecycle writes on the Governance writer.
Resolve and mark governed_migration_execute envelopes through the Governance store in both primary and legacy route implementations.
When Migration 1050 readiness fails because the Governance envelope ledger is unavailable, retain the existing read-only full role inspection.
Require the inspection to prove runtime=nonempty_objects and exactly governance,runtime_persistence=zero_objects before emitting a Recovery handoff.
Emit only the existing canonical Issue #6813 baseline-rebuild prepare command; do not dispatch it, do not create an approval on behalf of the operator, and do not execute any mutation.
Leave actual role rebuild execution to the existing server-derived Recovery plan, role-bundle binding, single-step approval, execution-ticket, and same-cycle readback lifecycle.
assertions: No new migration or DDL is introduced by this patch.
No caller-selected database, SQL, credential, provider operation, deployment, or raw shell is introduced.
Migration 225 remains verification-only and no synthetic Apply ledger is written.
The recovery handoff is emitted only for the exact zero-object role set governance,runtime_persistence.
The prepare command is evidence only and automatic execution/replay are false.
Every consequential Recovery role step still requires a separate server-issued single-step approval.
The changed Governance writer regression test is registered under the canonical governance_db_privilege_readiness test authority.
The recovery handoff change-contract itself is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths; autonomous merge remains forbidden.
Migration 1052 readiness regression proves persisted governed-migration envelopes resolve from the Governance store and cannot regress to the legacy Runtime readPool contract.

phases.objective: After merge and exact runtime deployment, rerun Migration 1050 readiness. If the same zero-object role set remains current, obtain a fresh baseline-rebuild preparation and then require the server-issued role-by-role approvals.
